tips.text: Aim High Note at the enemy's feet, then poke again once they are low. It hurts much more the lower their health is.
Start with Beat Drop on an enemy who is already slowed so they get rooted. Hit one who can't move and they are stunned.
Cast Surround Sound when you already have a shield to heal your team after a short delay. It shields and speeds up you and your allies too.
Cast your spells near your partner so you both get Notes. Then auto-attack to fire them for extra range and damage.
Watch your Echo stacks. When the last one is lit, your next basic spell casts twice, so save it for a key poke or a pick.
Hit an enemy with Encore, then follow up with Beat Drop. The charm lets it stun them.
In a team fight, fire Encore through your allies. Each champion it hits extends its range, so it can reach far-off enemies.
Hold Beat Drop to stop enemies diving you. It travels a long way and hits every enemy in the line.

combos.name: Charm into stun
combos.when: When your ultimate has charmed an enemy and you want a longer lockdown.
combos.text: The charm counts as an immobilize, so Beat Drop on a charmed enemy stuns them instead of only slowing. It chains well with allied follow-up.

tips.text: Keep your distance from Alistar. Headbutt and Pulverize together can lock you down, and you are fragile.
Hit Alistar with Beat Drop as he runs in. The slow gives you time to back away.
Cast Surround Sound before Alistar engages. The shield absorbs some of his burst.
Hold Encore for when Alistar commits. While Unbreakable Will is active, wait before you hit him.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line. Its stun only lands where the ice detonates, so step aside.
Hit Anivia with Beat Drop when she is slowed by your ally. It roots her and gives you time to follow up.
Use Surround Sound before you trade. Its shield absorbs some of her Frostbite damage.
Stand away from Glacial Storm. It slows you, and over time it deals heavy damage.
Kill Anivia's egg quickly after Rebirth. Use Encore to pull your team in on her, and do not leave it to chance.

comboRefs.note: Charm then Beat Drop stuns Anivia, giving allies a longer lockdown window against her.

tips.text: Fire Beat Drop at Bard after your ally slows him; he is rooted instead, which makes your follow-up spells much easier to land.
Aim Beat Drop down the lane so it hits Bard and his partner together; it keeps going after the first hit.
Stay out of a straight line with Bard's allies. Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second enemy or a wall, so step out of the line when it comes.
Hit Bard with High Note once he is hurt; it deals much more damage to low-health champions.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine to destroy it before his partner can use it.
Use Surround Sound before a trade to shield yourself and your partner, then cast it again later while shielded to heal.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits one of them first; it only pulls the first enemy it touches.
Hit Blitzcrank with Beat Drop when he runs in with Overdrive; his self-slow afterwards makes him easy to catch.
Poke with High Note from long range, since Blitzcrank must come close to do anything.
Don't rely on a shield against Blitzcrank's ultimate; Static Field destroys it and silences you.
Use Encore to charm Blitzcrank if he gets close, then follow with Beat Drop to stun him.
Dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame; Brand needs one to land before his stun combo works. Walk sideways out of the line.
Hit Brand with Beat Drop when he commits to a cast; it slows him, and rooting a slowed target keeps him there for your allies.
Cast Surround Sound before Brand's burst so you and your partner have a shield. Cast it twice for a delayed heal.
Stay apart from your partner when Brand casts Pyroclasm; it bounces between close enemies and its first missile is slow.
Poke Brand with High Note from long range; it hits harder against low health targets.
Aim High Note around Braum's raised shield, or wait for Unbreakable to end. His shield destroys projectiles from the side it faces.
Use Beat Drop when Braum drops Unbreakable. Fire it before he faces you, so he can't absorb it.
Hit an enemy who is already slowed with Beat Drop to root them. Your carry's slows set it up.
Stay out of Winter's Bite range. It starts his stun stacks, and your allies' attacks add to them.
Cast Surround Sound before a trade to shield your lane partner and yourself against his poke.
Use Encore when Braum and his carry are lined up. It can hit allies too, so it reaches further.
Hit Camille with Beat Drop after she is slowed by your ally; she is rooted instead, which makes her easy to hit with High Note.
Keep Beat Drop ready for when Camille dashes in with Hookshot; she is a short-range fighter and a slow stops her from reaching you.
Poke Camille with High Note from long range; it hits harder the lower her health is.
Cast Surround Sound before Camille closes in on you or your ally; the shield soaks her burst.
Encore's charm lets Beat Drop stun Camille, so use it to catch her when she locks onto your carry with The Hextech Ultimatum.

comboRefs.note: Encore's charm can catch Camille, and Beat Drop then stuns her, though her ultimate can untarget her.

tips.text: Hit Janna with Beat Drop after something slows her. She gets rooted instead, which sets up your next spells.
Stay out of Zephyr range when you can. Her slow makes you easy to hit with her Howling Gale.
Aim High Note at Janna when she is low, because it hits harder the less health a champion has.
Do not use Encore when Janna's Monsoon is ready; she can knock your team back and ruin the fight.
Listen for Howling Gale charging in the brush and sidestep it.
Stay out of Karma's Inner Flame line; getting slowed lets her Focused Resolve root you, and then Beat Drop will not save you.
Use Beat Drop on Karma when she is already slowed by your ally; it roots her instead.
Move away from Karma's Focused Resolve tether before it ends, and do not stand still near her.
Run out of the circle Karma leaves behind with Mantra on Inner Flame; it ruptures for heavy damage.
Use High Note when Karma is low on health; it hurts more the less health she has.
Keep Beat Drop for when Leona dashes in. She is rooted only briefly, so slow her first if you can to get a longer disable.
Poke Leona with High Note from long range. Stay far back, since Zenith Blade gets her to you fast.
Cast Surround Sound before Leona lands her combo. The shield absorbs some of the damage and the speed helps you get away.
Walk out of the center of Solar Flare. Only the center stuns you, so move quickly when it appears.
Stay out of Lulu's Glitterlance line; being slowed makes your Beat Drop root you if it hits.
Hit Lulu with Beat Drop after your ally slows her; she is then rooted and easy to follow up on.
Use High Note on Lulu when she is low on health; it deals much more damage then.
Keep Surround Sound ready for when Lulu's Whimsy or Glitterlance comes; the shield softens the trade.
Lulu's Wild Growth knocks up and slows when your team commits; make fights short or stay back from the enlarged ally.
Use Beat Drop on Lux right after she is slowed by your ally. It roots her.
Sidestep Light Binding. It roots the first two enemies it hits, so do not stand in line with your ally.
Cast Surround Sound with a shield already up when you expect to trade. It heals you and your ally afterward.
Use High Note on Lux when she is low. Her missing health makes it hit much harder.
Do not stand in Lucent Singularity. Leave before it bursts, or you take damage and a lingering slow.
Watch for the red line before Final Spark and step aside. Encore's charm can start a fight, but only if you do not get hit first.
Keep Beat Drop ready for when Maokai dashes in or walks up. It slows him, and a slowed target who is hit again gets rooted.
Do not throw spells at Maokai while he is dashing with Twisted Advance. He cannot be targeted, so the spells are wasted.
Hold your spells when only Maokai is in range, since every spell that hits him shortens his self-heal cooldown. Aim High Note at his partner instead.
Stay out of brush where a Sapling could be waiting. Walking past one gets you slowed and revealed.
Use Encore to charm Maokai if he ults you or your partner. Spread out and watch for his Nature's Grasp wall, because it is a projectile that can be dodged.
Wait for Mel to use Rebuttal before you throw High Note or Beat Drop; it destroys enemy projectiles in its nova.
Hit Mel with Beat Drop when she is already slowed so she is rooted, then follow with High Note while she can't move.
Step out of the lingering field from Solar Snare, or you will keep taking damage and be slowed.
Keep your health up against Mel's trades. Her hits stack Overwhelm, and a low-health target gets executed.
Use Surround Sound to shield yourself and your carry before Mel trades; the shield soaks her poke.
Aim Beat Drop at Milio after he is slowed by an ally; the slow becomes a root, and a charm from Encore turns it into a stun.
Throw High Note at Milio when he is low on Health; it hits much harder on weakened champions.
Catch Milio without his allies close; Riot says he is much less mobile alone. Poke him then.
Stand out of line when Milio casts Ultra Mega Fire Kick; it is a straight shot that stops on the first enemy, so keep a minion or ally in front.
Cast Surround Sound before a trade so your Shield is up; recasting it with a Shield already up adds a heal.
Hit Milio with Encore before he can press Breath of Life; it cleanses charm, so bait it out first.
Stand behind minions so Dark Binding hits them first and not you.
Wait for Morgana to use Black Shield before you go in with Beat Drop or Encore; the shield blocks your crowd control.
Hit Morgana with High Note to break her Black Shield; it deals magic damage.
Use Surround Sound to shield yourself against her poke, and walk out of Tormented Shadow.
Stay out of Aqua Prison range and walk around the slow bubble; it lands after a delay, so keep moving sideways when Nami casts it.
Once Nami has wasted Aqua Prison, step up and trade with High Note, since her long cooldown leaves you safe for a while.
Hit Nami with Beat Drop after her allies have slowed her, so she is rooted instead of just slowed.
Keep Surround Sound for when you get shielded or hit; casting it while already shielded adds a heal for you and your ally.
Use Encore on the enemy when they are far away or hit by Tidal Wave; it charms them and can reach farther through other champions.
Stay behind your minions and away from Nautilus. Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way can block it.
Poke Nautilus with High Note when he stays back. It deals more damage as his health drops, so keep it for when he is low.
If Nautilus hooks you or your ally, hit him with Beat Drop. He is stunned, and the pull slows him too.
Use Surround Sound on you and your carry when Nautilus comes in. The shield and speed help you avoid his hook and dive.
Use Encore on Nautilus when he dives in. A charmed Nautilus cannot move in to hook, and your team can hit him.
Do not walk into Nautilus when his first attack will root you. After Riptide, wait for the waves to finish before you move.

comboRefs.note: Encore's charm is an immobilize, so Beat Drop stuns Nautilus, locking him down for his allies to punish.

tips.text: Aim Beat Drop at Neeko when she is already slowed so it roots her instead; it also stuns her if she is immobilized.
Hold Encore for when Neeko tries to disguise and jump in; its charm lets Beat Drop stun her.
Throw High Note at Neeko when she is hurt; it hits harder the lower her health is.
Cast Surround Sound before Neeko's Tangle-Barbs lands; the shield soaks some damage and the speed helps you step away.
Stay out of line with Tangle-Barbs and keep minions out of its path; it grows stronger after it hits one.
Aim Beat Drop at Pantheon as he leaps in; he is slowed and then rooted if it hits twice, which makes him easy to hit.
Do not throw spells into Aegis Assault from the front; wait for it to end or hit him from the side or behind.
Use High Note to poke from range. Stay healthy, because Pantheon's thrown Comet Spear hurts you more when you are low.
Cast Surround Sound before Pantheon jumps on you or your ally; the shield soaks his burst.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, move away from the marked area, or charm him with Encore when he lands.
Keep Beat Drop for when Poppy commits with Heroic Charge or walks up to trade. Slowed first, she gets rooted.
Stand away from walls. Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you and hurts.
Poppy's Steadfast Presence stops dashes, so do not rely on a dash to escape while it is active.
Use High Note to poke from long range. Poppy has no ranged attack but Hammer Shock, so stay outside its reach.
When Poppy starts spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict, step out of its path or charm her with Encore.
Step on Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her shield.
Aim High Note at Pyke when he is low; it hits much harder on hurt targets, and the area catches him when he is hidden nearby.
Hold Beat Drop for when Pyke dashes or pulls someone in. It slows him, and if he is already slowed or stopped it roots or stuns him.
Use Encore on Pyke when he dives in. The charm stops him, and Beat Drop then stuns him.
Cast Surround Sound when Pyke's hook is about to land. The shield soaks the damage, and the speed helps your ally get away.
Stay behind your minions. Pyke's Bone Skewer stops at the first enemy it hits and has short range uncharged.
Stay away from low-health allies. Pyke can execute them with Death From Below and then reach you.
Hit Rakan with Beat Drop after something else has slowed him; he gets rooted instead of just slowed, which sets up your follow-up.
Catch Rakan with Beat Drop when he is knocked up or charmed. It stuns him for as long as the effect lasts.
Aim Encore at Rakan when he is alone. It charms him, and his dashes mostly need an ally to land on.
Use High Note on Rakan after he lands Grand Entrance. He stands still briefly, and it hurts most when he is low on Health.
Cast Surround Sound before Rakan's burst lands, so you and your carry have a shield.

comboRefs.note: Encore charms Rakan, then Beat Drop stuns him, locking down a mobile champion.

tips.text: Aim Beat Drop at Rell when she leaps in or gets close; she is then slowed or stopped, which sets up your next hit.
Stay out of Shattering Strike range and Rell has to walk up to you. Her stun is short, but she can follow it with her allies.
Don't rely on Surround Sound's shield when Rell is near; Shattering Strike destroys shields before it hits.
Use High Note from long range to poke Rell while she is mounted and slower to close the gap.
Save Encore for when Rell is committed; the charm can also let Beat Drop stun her.

comboRefs.note: Charm then Beat Drop stun gives lockdown to punish Rell's engage, since Rell must close in.

tips.text: Aim Beat Drop at Senna when she is already slowed or rooted; it then roots or stuns her for a long time, which sets up a kill.
Use High Note on Senna once her health is low; it hits much harder on missing health and the area is wide.
Stay out of Senna's long attack range and walk out of the line before Last Embrace sticks; its root comes about a second after it lands.
Cast Surround Sound before the enemy trades so your shield soaks the poke. Cast it again while shielded to heal your team afterward.
Use Encore on a grouped enemy team in a fight. It charms them and can reach far by passing through allies.
Hit Shen with Beat Drop when he dashes in; he is stunned if he is immobilized, so combine it with your ally's crowd control.
Keep your distance and poke with High Note; Shen has no ranged attack to answer it.
Watch for Shadow Dash; the taunt forces you to attack him, so stay behind your allies when he is ready.
Don't rely on Surround Sound's shield into Shen's empowered attacks; his Twilight Assault deals extra damage based on your max health.
After level 6, Shen can teleport to a hurt ally with Stand United, so don't chase a kill far from your team.

comboRefs.note: Encore's charm makes Beat Drop stun instead of slow, locking Shen down after he commits.

tips.text: Aim Beat Drop at Sona when she walks up to cast; if she is already slowed, she gets rooted.
Sona is fragile, so use High Note on her when she is hurt; it deals more damage the lower her health.
Stay out of Crescendo's line. Don't stand next to your carry when Sona's ultimate is ready.
Use Surround Sound before Sona's poke lands, so the shield soaks the damage.
Use Encore when Sona is far from her team; the charm stops her from casting while you fight.

comboRefs.note: Sona's listed kit has no escape from a charm, so R into E turns it into a longer stun lockdown.

tips.text: Use Beat Drop on Soraka after something slows her. She is then rooted, and an Encore charm lets Beat Drop stun her.
Dodge Starcall by moving sideways. It is a slow star and hitting you heals her.
Stay out of Equinox. Leave the area before it ends, or you are silenced and then rooted.
Cast Surround Sound before fighting so you and your ally have a shield. A second cast while shielded also heals later.
Use High Note on Soraka once she is low on health. It deals more damage the less health she has.
Hit Swain with Beat Drop after something slows him. He gets rooted instead of just slowed.
Swain's Nevermove roots you when it comes back to him. Stay out of its path and out of range of his Death's Hand.
Use High Note from long range to poke. It hurts more when Swain is low on health.
Move out of the area Vision of Empire marks when you see it appear. It explodes late and slows you.
Cast Surround Sound when Swain threatens you, to shield yourself and your ally. Casting it again while shielded adds a delayed heal.
Hit Tahm Kench with Beat Drop after something else has slowed him; he gets rooted instead of just slowed, which makes him easy to follow up on.
Stand back and poke with High Note. It reaches far and hits harder the lower his Health gets.
Keep your distance when Tahm Kench has Tongue Lash ready. Being hit can start stacks toward a Devour on you.
Cast Surround Sound before a trade to shield you and your ally, then cast it again while shielded to heal after a short delay.
Use Encore on Tahm Kench to charm him. A charm is an immobilize, so Beat Drop then stuns him.

comboRefs.note: Charm then Beat Drop gives a longer lockdown, enough to punish Tahm if he is caught after engaging.

tips.text: Don't stand in a line with minions when Taric is near; Dazzle bursts after a delay, so step out of the beam as it winds up.
Hit Taric with Beat Drop when he walks up to a minion wave. Punish his approach, since his basic attacks lower his cooldowns.
Use High Note from long range. It hurts more as Taric's health drops, so keep poking him between his heals.
Charm with Encore, then follow with Beat Drop to stun them. Against Taric's ultimate, kill someone or back off before it goes off.
Stay out of Death Sentence range, and keep minions between you and Thresh. His scythe stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way blocks it.
Move as soon as you see Thresh start throwing his scythe. The cast takes a moment, so you can sidestep it.
Use Beat Drop to slow Thresh when he walks up. Follow with a second Beat Drop and he is rooted.
Cast Surround Sound before a trade so you have a shield up. Cast it again while shielded to heal your team later.
Aim High Note at Thresh when he is low. It hits harder the less health he has, and it keeps going after a hit.
Hold Encore for when Thresh commits to a hook or Flay. The charm lets you land Beat Drop's stun on him.

comboRefs.note: Charm then Beat Drop stuns, a longer lockdown on Thresh if he is caught without his lantern or box.

tips.text: Keep Beat Drop for when Vel'Koz is already slowed or stuck, so he is rooted or stunned and cannot dodge his way out.
Hit Vel'Koz with Encore when he starts channeling his ray. The charm interrupts him, and allies you pass through extend its range.
Charm him with Encore, then follow with Beat Drop for a stun.
Vel'Koz has little mobility, so line up Beat Drop and High Note when your jungler comes to gank.
Use Surround Sound to absorb his poke, and cast it again while the shield is up to heal your team.

comboRefs.note: Charm then Beat Drop stuns, and Vel'Koz has no listed dash or escape to avoid the lockdown.

tips.text: Close the distance on Xerath. Beat Drop hits him from long range and he has little escape once it lands.
Hit Xerath with High Note when he stands still charging Arcanopulse; he is slowed and easy to hit.
Use Surround Sound on yourself and your ally before he throws Shocking Orb to soak poke.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath, and keep a minion between you so Shocking Orb is blocked.
Charm him with Encore when he channels Rite of the Arcane to interrupt it.
Aim Beat Drop at Yuumi when she is not attached to an ally. Attached, she can't be targeted except by towers, so wait for her to detach.
Hit the enemy carry with High Note while Yuumi is off them. She protects them only when attached.
Open with High Note, then use Beat Drop. The enemy is slowed first, so Beat Drop roots them.
Charm with Encore, then use Beat Drop to stun them. Yuumi's Final Chapter waves can't be dodged easily, so fight at range.
Use Surround Sound before trades so the shield absorbs Prowling Projectile poke.
Hit Zilean with Beat Drop when he is already slowed. The root keeps him still for a Time Bomb-free follow-up.
Use High Note on Zilean once he is low on health. It hits harder the more health he has missing.
Step out of any Time Bomb quickly. A second bomb on you sets off the first and stuns you.
Zilean is fragile, so focus him with your ally. Charm him with Encore to get the kill.
If you can match his speed, wait until his Chronoshift has faded before you land the killing blow on his ally.
Walk over Zyra's seeds to destroy them before she can grow plants from them. Do it before she casts.
Stay out of Grasping Roots range and sidestep it. Being rooted in lane gets you hit by her plants.
Hit Zyra with High Note when she steps up to place seeds. It has long range and hits harder the lower her health is.
Use Beat Drop to slow Zyra when she commits. If she is already slowed, it roots her.
Cast Surround Sound for the shield when Zyra threatens a trade. It helps you and your partner take less damage from her spells.

comboRefs.note: Encore's charm sets up a Beat Drop stun on Zyra, who can't act while locked down in lane.
